card.name: Qualifier words inside clinical phrases
card.fires_on: A word or word part in the middle of a clinical noun phrase that still needs its head noun, such as 'type 1', 'serum quantitative', 'multiple dose' or 'intravenous'. It fires mostly in label headings and dosing instructions.

modes.label: Modifier before a noun
modes.description: A qualifier sits just before the noun it describes in a label phrase.

modes.label: Partway through a term
modes.description: The marked piece is the start or middle of a longer medical word.
modes.example: Table 1: Mon<<otherapy>> Target Total Daily Maintenance Dosing for Patients

modes.label: Verb after a disease name
modes.description: The word 'is' follows a disorder name that is about to be defined.
